laws_and_papers.topic: Batters Crossing / Out Caught Strike Rotation (2022 Code)
laws_and_papers.summary: When a batter is out Caught, the new batter must always take strike at the end where the dismissed striker was positioned, regardless of whether batters crossed prior to the catch.
A bowler shall not bowl two overs consecutively in the same innings.

laws_and_papers.topic: No Ball Penalty, Extra Runs & Re-bowled Delivery
laws_and_papers.summary: Awards 1 penalty run, does not count towards the 6-ball over limit, requires re-bowling delivery, and restricts dismissals to Run Out / Obstructing.
Awards 1 penalty run, does not count as a legal delivery in the over, and must be re-bowled.
Substitute fielders are allowed for injured/ill players, but substitutes cannot bat, bowl, or act as captain.
Either the striker or non-striker can be run out while out of their ground. If non-striker is run out, striker remains on strike.
Fair catch by fielder or keeper before ball touches ground.
Ball pitches in line or off side, impacts inline, and would hit wickets.
